tips_summary: Use broad-spectrum sunscreen daily to help protect against further discoloration and visible aging. A gentle moisturizer and a gradually introduced retinoid may support smoother-looking skin.

tips.title: Daily sun protection
points: Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher each morning.
Reapply every two hours during extended outdoor exposure.

tips.title: Gentle skin routine
points: Use a mild cleanser and a fragrance-free moisturizer.
Introduce a low-strength retinoid slowly, and stop if irritation develops.

treatment: A consistent sunscreen routine can help limit worsening sun spots and uneven tone.
A clinician-guided retinoid program may improve the appearance of fine lines and texture.
If desired, consult a dermatologist about options for persistent discoloration or redness.
